tagline: G-funk whistles, Moog-style leads, talkbox, funk bass and West Coast keys: 70 presets from 8 engines.
sub: G-funk whistles, leads, talkbox and keys
gumroad_title: SAN ANDREAS LEAD - G-Funk Lead Synthesizer VST3 + AU Plugin (70 Presets) | G-Funk, West Coast, Funk
summary: A synthesizer plugin (VST3 and Audio Unit) with eight synthesis engines (G-Funk, Moog, Square, Talkbox, Bass, Rhodes, Strings and Clav) and 70 factory presets.
about: SAN ANDREAS LEAD, sold under the HUMPIRE brand by DJBILBOX BEATS, generates every sound in real time with no samples. Choose one of eight engines (G-Funk, Moog, Square, Talkbox, Bass, Rhodes, Strings and Clav), shape it with five character controls (TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH and TEXTURE), then run it through a multimode filter, an amplitude envelope, an LFO, distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb. The character is sunny and smooth, built around gliding mono leads.
22 of the 70 presets load in Poly mode and 48 in Mono mode, so you can play chords or single-note lines from the first preset.
Built for G-Funk and West Coast Hip-Hop, funk and R&B hooks, Trap leads and lowrider-style bass lines.
Moog, Rhodes and Clav are trademarks of their owners and are used only to describe a sound style.

features.d: G-funk whistle, Moog-style lead, PWM square lead, vowel talkbox, funk bass, Rhodes-style FM piano, lowrider strings and clav.
TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH and TEXTURE reshape each engine.
Seven banks of ten sounds, from G-funk whistles and Moog-style leads to talkbox, funk bass, West Coast keys and lowrider strings.
Low pass, high pass or band pass, with resonance and a dedicated attack, decay, sustain and release envelope.
Distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
Sine, triangle, saw, square or sample and hold, sent to pitch, filter, amplitude or timbre.
On-screen keyboard (MIDI notes 48 to 96), pitch bend and mod wheel, up to 16 voices in Poly mode.
Everything you make with it is yours.

includes: SAN ANDREAS LEAD plugin (Windows VST3; macOS VST3 + Audio Unit)

faq.q: Which DAWs does it work in?
faq.a: It is a VST3 instrument on Windows and macOS, plus Audio Unit on macOS. It is designed for FL Studio and should load in any host that supports these formats.
No. Every sound is generated in real time by one of eight synthesis engines.
Most lead, talkbox and bass presets load in Mono with glide. Switch VOICE MODE to Poly for chords; the West Coast Keys and Lowrider Strings banks already load in Poly.

faq.q: Can I save my own presets?
faq.a: Yes. The disk icon saves a .sapreset file, and your presets appear in the User submenu of the preset menu.
